intent: Warm olive-bronze sentinel plate under domed pale-stone pauldrons on gold rims, a stepped stone crown with a gold sun disc rising behind it, a gold sun on the stone breastplate and gold trim at belt, wrists and knees, the left pauldron deliberately broken to its socket and lichen on the stone: a rounded, gold-sunned silhouette that reads apart from grey iron and cool fenscale from the high camera.
requests: A matte, weathered pale-stone material: Marble is the only pale stone to hand and reads smooth beside the bronze.
A lichen or moss material that reads as growth rather than a flat patch; Slate is a stand-in.
A gold that keeps its colour on vertical faces under the mood lighting; the sun discs read bronze-brown from the front.
